about: The delay of the effect rack of the Audio Unit on a click of ours played by its noise oscillator (44.1 kHz; 0.5 at 0.4 s after a tone of 1 kHz at 0.001, the rack awake; 3.2 s of silence after it), its plain params named as its state has them (kParamTimeL and kParamTimeR, kParamOffsetL and kParamOffsetR, kParamBeatSync 0: the times free, kParamFeedback %, kParamWet %, kParamFreq Hz, kParamBW, kParamMode, kParamLevelOut a knob 0..1, kParamLink, kParamHQ). An echo is where the click of the dry render comes out of the wet one: [lag in samples, gain] (the correlation with the dry click: a filtered echo has a gain under its level). impulse: `click` the dry click as rendered, 128 samples from 32 before its peak, of the peak; `echoes` the first three echoes the same way (their `lags`) at the free time 0.1, the feedback and the filter of a fresh delay, the wet signal alone. fresh: the defaults of its knobs and how far a render with them written is from the one of a fresh delay (dB under it). free: [the knob of both times, the first echo of the left channel (its lag; null: none in 3 s), of the right one], no feedback. apart: the knobs of the channels apart and `echo`, the first echo of each. tempos: [the tempo of the host (null: it tells none), the first echo of a fresh time], the sync on (the default). sync: [the knob of both times, the first echo] at 240 BPM (a beat is 11025 samples); offsets: [kParamOffsetL and R, the first echo] of a fresh time at 240 BPM. feedback: [%, the repeats of the click in the left channel] at the free time 0.1, the filter wide (1 kHz, BW 8.25); uneven: the repeats of each channel at 50 % with the times 0.05 and 0.08. mix: [the knob 0..1, the gain of the dry click, the gain of its echo against the one at 100 %]; level: [kParamLevelOut, the gain of the dry click against the one at 0.5] at the mix 50 %. filter: [kParamFreq, kParamBW, the gain of the echo (dB against the dry click) at each of frequencies], no feedback. hq: [kParamHQ, the first echo [lag, gain]] at the free time 0.10001. modes: a click in one channel alone (`input`) by kParamMode at 50 % of feedback, the filter at 1 kHz and BW 2, the times 0.05 and 0.08: the echoes of the left channel, of the right one. lfo: LFO 1 (its default shape: a triangle from 0 up, from the note) routed to kParamTimeL and kParamTimeR (mod slots, source 6) by `amount` % of their travel from the free time `base`, all wet, no feedback, the filter wide, a sine of `period` samples through it; `law` [the share of the travel, the first echo of a click] (Macro 1 routed alike, held: the time a share gives); the delay a sample is read at is the triangle from the sample `start` (of the sine) through `law` and a one-pole of `tau` ms, within `rms` samples. lfoDivisions: the rate of LFO 1 at `knob` (the `division` its menu shows: `hz` at 120 BPM, the tempo it takes without one of the host), its own fit. lfoRows: [the division (its index), the sample from the start of the sine, the delay it is read at there] every 32 samples over a cycle from 1 s, out of the phase of the render against the dry one (their analytic signals). scripts/renders/run.mjs --only=delay [--parts=static,lfo]
